description: Student-facing school employment-center Q&A product rebuilt around a Vercel-chatbot-inspired frontend and FastAPI official-first retrieval backend.
current_goal: Complete H8 delivery hygiene: commit the verified v2 branch, preserve screenshots and docs, and push once a remote is available.
rules: Preserve official-information precedence at all times.
Prefer a polished, trustworthy frontend over generic admin-tool visuals.
Keep admin tooling lightweight and token-based for phase 1.
Do not reintroduce dual-mode product scope in MVP.
Do not import Auth.js, Postgres, or account/session logic from vercel/chatbot.
